title: CY61032: Newer Asymmetric Reactions

Prerequisite : CY30103Principles of asymmetric reaction and synthesis; Kinetic
resolution, Dynamic kinetic resolution (DKR) and autocatalytic reactions;
Chemo-, regio-, diastereo- and enantio-controlled approaches; Chirality
transfer and relay; Asymmetric inductions; Chiral pools, auxiliaries and
